Specification: This module provides only type-level documentation and a dummy definition for an ERC20-related specification. The comments describe uninterpreted account addresses, transaction record shapes for transfer, approve, and transferFrom, a discriminated union of transactions, and a state record containing balances, allowances, pending transactions, the last transaction, and the next transaction identifier. The actual TLA+ content of the module consists solely of one top-level operator defined to be TRUE; there are no variables, actions, temporal properties, assumptions, or proofs in this file.
